title: Denial of service (DoS and DDoS) and mitigation

videos.script: A denial of service steals nothing. It uses up something a service needs, until the people entitled to it are turned away. {{denial}} What gets used up decides where it can be stopped. Bandwidth, a table in a device, or the application's own work. {{kinds}} In this lesson you will see the defence Linux already runs against half-open connections, and shorten how long the firewall remembers them. {{syn}} You will cap how many connections one client may hold, and watch the fifth one refused. {{limit}} You will check that the company's name server cannot be borrowed to attack somebody else. {{reflect}} And you will face the kind of attack no rule at home can absorb, and what has to be arranged before it arrives. {{upstream}}
